review.description: Hosted setup and exact-source verification now retain the bounded journal through success, failure and cancellation, finalizing before artifact transfer and attempting seven-day upload. Product flows, browser samples and release provenance remain unchanged.
review.implementation: Inspected ci.py selected-journal refresh using the keyword-only resolved plan before version collection, unchanged exact comparison/bootstrap selection and manifest execution, workflow startup after checkout and always-finalization before all artifacts. The helper, owned runner and Make graph are byte-identical to the earlier slices. Upload uses the selected single JSON, fixed name, seven-day retention and fail-open transfer.
review.tests: Read actual selected-journal ci.run_verification regressions for push, PR, manual main and pinned-root plans on success/failure; source remains initial, comparison is exact and no argument reparse occurs. KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit143 during version collection persists the resolved plan and starts no worker. Workflow assertions require always-finalization before every upload and timing upload last. Existing partial setup/privacy/Make/cancellation regressions remain unchanged.
